sentences.text:
Bench: K.Lakshman
 The Hon'Ble Justice K.Lakshman
This application is filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C., to quash the proceedings in Crime No.105 of 2020 pending on the file of Mahabubabad Rural Police Station.
Petitioners herein are A-1 and A-2 in the said crime.
The offences alleged against the petitioners are under Sections 420, 328, 270 and 273 read with Section 34 IPC.

2. Sri Laxmaiah Kanchani, learned counsel for the petitioners, would submit that this Court in a batch of Criminal Petitions, vide order dt.27-08-2018, held that the police are incompetent to take cognizance of offences punishable under Sections 54 And 59 (1) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
Following the said principle, this Court vide order dt.29-07-2020 in Crl.P.No.3054 of 2020, allowed the Criminal Petition filed by A-3 and A-4 in the very same crime.
3. Considering the said facts, this Criminal petition is also allowed in terms of the orders dt.27-08-2018 in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch, and dt.27-07-2020 in Crl.P.No.3054 of 2020.
4. Miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition, shall stand closed.
Registry is directed to attach a copy of both the above said orders along with the copy of this order.

B/o.
